prior_universal_induction.cleanup: All k+1 remainder snapshots, private k root bits, operand and helper are charged. Operand construction is reversed per stage; complete compute is reversed after copying root bits to arbitrary output.
prior_universal_induction.induction: In either old-sign branch the trial equals M-(2Q+1)², with M=4N+d. If trial>=0 choose new Q=2Q+1 and R=M-Q'²; otherwise choose Q'=2Q and R=M-(Q'+1)². Since Q²<=N<(Q+1)², M lies between (2Q)² and (2Q+2)², so this choice is exactly isqrt(M).
prior_universal_induction.intermediate_policy: 4R+d may overflow signed k+2. All updates are modulo2**(k+2); the proved final exact remainder fits that signed word, so the final sign is correct. No promise that every pre-add intermediate fits.
prior_universal_induction.invariant: Q=isqrt(N); R=N-Q² if nonnegative, else N-(Q+1)²
prior_universal_induction.operand_identity: Low bits11; each higher bit is Q_bit XOR NOT(old_R_sign). This equals -(4Q+1) or +(4Q+3) modulo2**(k+2), respectively.
prior_universal_induction.proof_scope: Algebraic induction covers every guarded input. Finite bookkeeping and emitted tests check realization; no exhaustive72-bit enumeration, continuous-dollar or physical-speedup certification.
prior_universal_induction.recurrence: R'=4R+d-(4Q+1) if old R>=0; R'=4R+d+(4Q+3) otherwise; Q'=2Q+int(R'>=0)
prior_universal_induction.remainder_correction: No remainder is externally output. A negative final R would become the usual nonnegative remainder after adding 2Q+1; root-only clean-XOR emission may reverse the uncorrected signed history directly.
prior_universal_induction.scaling: Read radicand pair at original source indices 2*position+bit-fraction_bits; absent indices are zero. Leading padding and all lower fractional zeros are retained.
prior_universal_induction.signed_bound: -(2Q+1)<=R<=2Q, Q<2**stage. At final k stages, R lies strictly within [-2**(k+1),2**(k+1)), representable in signed k+2 bits.
